title: Keep in-memory mailbox diagnostics available when the pending-wake count fails
outcome: A pending-wake store error is reported for that section while process-local refusal, 5xx, durability and link histories remain readable.
acceptance: The diagnostics endpoint returns the in-memory sections when the pending-wake count fails, with an explicit unavailable count section.
A controlled store failure test discriminates partial diagnostics from a whole-endpoint error.
